[[File:CairhienFlag.png|thumb|The setting sun flag of Cairhien]]
The '''Sunset Convocations''' are celebrations that occur after the coronation of the [[Cairhien]] monarch. A Convocation occurs every third day for the first nine days after the coronation. Only three are known about though the set may continue longer if uninterrupted.
